name: lemmy
description: Personal finance tracker: FastAPI + SQLite backend, React + Vite frontend.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt -r backend/requirements-dev.txt && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir backend --reload-dir backend --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:reset: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('backend/data/lemmy.db', { force: true })" && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
